description: The plot illustrates how “Reliability Score” varies with “Cost” for three approaches (3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4). The x-axis is labeled “Cost,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 10 with tick labels at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 30 to 90 with labeled ticks at 30, 50, 70, and 90. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: the blue 3-Model Ensemble line decreases from about 83 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 75 at cost 10; the red 2-Model Ensemble line decreases from about 85 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 73 at cost 10; the gold GPT-4 line decreases from about 89 at cost 0 to about 64 at cost 5 and about 41 at cost 10.
